note.question: How do seller organization and percentage fee design interact in the daily deal market?
note.overview: The prosperity of the daily deal business has attracted more sellers to participate in daily deal campaigns with offering discounted deals via online platforms like Groupon and Juhuasuan. This gives rise to a new challenge for online platforms on how to efficiently organize a limited number of sellers to conduct daily deal campaigns. The paper's paper makes the first attempt to understand how different seller organization formats can influence the firms’ equilibrium strategies and profits in the daily deal market.
